title: VDCores Qwen3 1.7B Launch Pointer-Device Diagnostic
command: Monkey-patch dae_app, classify sampled direct 1D addresses with cudaPointerGetAttributes in the same process, then invoke the failing Qwen3-1.7B one-layer final_rms launch.
observation: All 80 sampled direct addresses were recognized by cudaPointerGetAttributes and copied by cudaMemcpy before launch. Direct load pointers spanned devices 0 and 7 while the launch context was device 0; SM64 pc1 used a device-7 direct-load pointer and the launch failed with illegal memory access.
blocker: The same-process launch shows a device-placement mismatch: VDCores launches on current device 0 while sampled Qwen direct-load source pointers include device 7. This explains the original cp_async_bulk illegal memory direction but still needs a co-located run before importing resource-policy timing.

summary.launch_exception: launch_dae failed: an illegal memory access was encountered
rules_out: unrecognized CUDA runtime pointer attributes as the cause of the first direct load failure
summary.next_debug_target: co-locate Qwen model weights and VDCores launcher buffers on one visible GPU and rerun the failing cut
